requirements.name: First Boot Wi-Fi password entry
requirements.implementation: Shows the selected SSID and a masked Password field, returns from the keyboard to explicit Connect and Cancel controls, and reports connecting, verified success, authentication failure, backend failure, and timeout states without logging the password.

requirements.name: Storage provisioning progress modal
requirements.implementation: Runs the existing guarded storage provisioner through an asynchronous QProcess, streams real stages, prevents duplicate requests and active dismissal, and enables Continue only after verified capacity and mount results.

requirements.name: One-time login instructions
requirements.implementation: Uses setup completion state plus installation-level acknowledgment persistence, documents the actual combination timing and lockout values, and remains manually available from Help.

requirements.name: Setup Wizard Bluetooth controller pairing
requirements.implementation: Invokes the same ControllerSettingsModal and authoritative exact-MAC USB-to-Bluetooth registration workflow used by the working desktop controller tab.

requirements.name: Wired controller status text
requirements.implementation: Changes only the desktop controller status presentation from Wired / USB to Wired.

requirements.name: First Boot Security Configuration
requirements.implementation: Adds Default and Custom profiles backed by the existing security configuration helper, validates supported settings, atomically persists them, and reads them back before reporting success.

requirements.name: First-login controller registration attention
requirements.implementation: Queries authoritative bridge registration_needed state for an attached USB controller without requiring an already registered transport, resets attention per login session, and routes Triangle to the existing registration modal.
